statement: Dolphin Real Wii Remote slot transmits guest-generated reports and receives physical reports, setting noncontinuous core mode at link, rather than running the native ControllerInterface MotionPlus calibration ladder. Thus specific MP, F7/F1/0x50 requirements are game/SDK dependent and no title-independent startup read/write sequence is verified. No Real-slot run is authorized.

applicability.revision: TR/Gen 2 pinned consumer paths; no retail or firmware revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Dolphin WiimoteReal.cpp 169-267,295-332,417-478; native CI differences 449-657. All acceptance/physical experiments explicitly not run.
